# Glyph SVGs

Vector copies of the in-game glyphs of the Warriors, Bards, Alchemists and Anchorites of *Chants of Sennaar*.
They come from the `COS_glyph_svgs.zip` archive in [EnBlkd/CoSTranslator](https://github.com/EnBlkd/CoSTranslator), a fan project
that has no license file. The glyph designs belong to Rundisc; this is an unofficial fan project and no ownership is claimed.

`tools/extract-svg-glyphs.ts` turns these files into `src/languages/<id>/glyphs.json`.
